claims.text: Mekong Chemical Industries most recently revised the expected startup of its Vung Tau steam cracker from 2027 to 2028.

citations.quote: Mekong Chemical Industries has revised the expected startup of its Vung Tau steam cracker from 2027 to 2028.

claims.text: The revision to the Vung Tau cracker's startup schedule was attributed to delayed delivery of the cracked gas compressor and slower-than-planned progress on the site's marine offloading facility.

citations.quote: The company attributed the revision to delayed delivery of the cracked gas compressor and to slower-than-planned progress on the site's marine offloading facility.

claims.text: The July 2026 announcement supersedes the previous schedule guidance issued by Mekong Chemical Industries in January 2026, which had targeted startup in 2027.

citations.quote: This announcement supersedes the schedule guidance issued by the company in January 2026.
Mekong Chemical Industries confirmed that construction of its Vung Tau steam cracker is progressing and that the company is targeting startup in 2027.

coverage_note: The evidence is limited to company press releases from Mekong Chemical Industries, which provide direct statements on the revised startup schedule and reasons for delay. No independent or third-party confirmation is present.
